intended_object: An R₀ (symmetric) topological space: for all points x and y, x ∈ closure {y} implies y ∈ closure {x}, i.e. the specialization relation is symmetric. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: In Mathlib, `x ⤳ y` (`Specializes x y`) is `𝓝 x ≤ 𝓝 y`. This is equivalent to "every neighbourhood of y contains x" and to "x ∈ closure {y}". The class requires `Std.Symm Specializes`, i.e. `x ⤳ y → y ⤳ x` for all x and y, which is exactly the standard R₀ axiom. It is also equivalent to the other common formulation: topologically distinguishable points have neighbourhoods separating each from the other. The class is stated for an arbitrary topological space, which is the natural generality, and it matches its docstring.
